theme_archetype.reasoning: Patients and seniors need warmth, calm, and trust. A clinical or dark tech UI feels alienating. We use grounded, tactile colors to reassure users during high-stress post-discharge periods.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#1F2421]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#1F2421]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6 to p-12) for senior accessibility. Prevent accidental clicks by adding ample negative space.

practitioner_portal.behavior: Dense, scanable data. Every widget stretches to fill height (`h-full`).

family_portal.behavior: Simple, large touch targets, single-column focus for mobile.

spacing_and_layout.containers: All bordered containers must have internal padding of at least p-6.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.default_cards: Tactile Neumorphism: Flat #FFFFFF background, subtle ambient shadow `shadow-sm`, AND a sharp 1px border `border-[#E6E4DE]` to ground it and ensure visibility for seniors.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Solid Background `#FAF9F6` with a hard bottom border. DO NOT use Glassmorphism for this medical app to prevent visual refraction of text.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.interactive_elements: Hover states must lift slightly `-translate-y-0.5` and darken border color. Active states must increase contrast.

components.file_upload: Massive drag-and-drop zone (`min-h-[300px]`), dashed border `border-2 border-dashed border-[#3B7062]/40`, large skeuomorphic icons (Camera / Document), button size `h-14`.
components.risk_badge: Large, bold typography. Must not rely on color alone (include text 'LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH' and an associated icon: Check, Warning, Alert).
components.medication_table: Shadcn Table heavily customized: alternating row colors `even:bg-[#F3F1EC]` for reading ease, `p-4` cell padding, minimum font size `text-base`.
components.chat_interface: Distinct speech bubbles. Family/Patient bubbles: `#3B7062` with white text. AI bubbles: `#F3F1EC` with dark text. Input field must be `min-h-[60px]` with a massive submit button.

motion.accessibility: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. No infinite looping animations. Entrances should be simple fade-ins (`opacity-0 to opacity-100`).

icons.sizing: Minimum `w-6 h-6` for inline, `w-12 h-12` for empty states/upload zones.

accessibility_requirements.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Avoid gray-on-gray.

hero_landing.description: Grandmother laughing with grandchildren. Use on the main landing page to evoke family reassurance and care.

practitioner_marketing.description: Confident male doctor using a tablet. Use for the Practitioner portal login or marketing section.

family_marketing.description: Smiling elderly woman. Use for patient profile placeholder or family portal onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Organic & Earthy color palette. No neon or default SaaS blue.
Build Shadcn components but override their default borders and radii to match the Tactile Neumorphism surface strategy (1px warm gray borders, soft shadows).
Ensure the Family/Carer portal is drastically simpler than the Practitioner portal. Use the Bento Grid for Family, Control Room Grid for Practitioners.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, form input, and interactive card.
Never use generic sans-serif (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use Outfit for headings and Work Sans for body.
Implement the drag-and-drop file upload using the specified colors and massive skeuomorphic icons to help seniors.
Always render the images provided in the media section; do not use placeholders.
